title: objectives/node@1 — causal objective/value graph node (COG-3)
description: A node in the shadow causal objective/value graph (docs/plans/cognitive-core-phase-3-contract-2026-07-22.md §4.1). kind is the graph-owned CLOSED node-kind enum (deliberately NOT the belief kind enum — beliefs describe the world, these describe intent). node_id is a DETERMINISTIC recorder-dialect digest of (kind, subject_key), never a build-time ULID. root_ref PRESENCE is schema-enforced on objective nodes (its RESOLVABILITY + roots_hash epoch match are a build-fold check in graph.py, never called a schema rejection). reversibility/captain_attention_cost are TYPED enums per foundry :105 — never numeric weights, never folded into a number. This schema is registry-PATH-resolved (framework/schemas/domains/objectives/) but validated with jsonschema.Draft202012Validator: its pattern keyword is outside the closed-subset registry interpreter (framework/triggers/schema_registry.py), mirroring the reference cross-check idiom at framework/triggers/tests/test_schema_registry.py:301-354.

subject_key.description: Cortex subject_key verbatim for evidence-anchored nodes; direction/<digest>, objective/<slug>, outcome/<slug>, constraint/<slug> per adapter

root_ref.description: The direction_root node id this objective resolves through + the roots_hash epoch it was authenticated against (:55). REQUIRED on objective nodes (presence only; resolvability is a graph.py build-fold check)

reversibility.description: TYPED enum per foundry :105 — never a numeric weight

captain_attention_cost.description: TYPED enum per foundry :105 — never a numeric weight

join_spec.description: On intervention nodes: adapter-derived (actor, action, subject) matcher tuples for consequence evidence about THIS intervention (§4.1, feeds §5.2b)

floors.description: On outcome/constraint nodes: named scorecard dimensions with independent floor values (§4.4)
